title: Esmaeilnezhad vows Iran volleyball will reach LA 2028 Olympics
body: TEHRAN - Iran men’s national volleyball team captain Amin Esmaeilnezhad has expressed confidence that Iran will qualify for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympic Games, despite widespread doubts among fans about the team’s chances.

title: Safarzadeh to fight for gold at Asian Para Games
body: TEHRAN - Iranian para-athletics star Hajar Safarzadeh has set her sights to win a gold medal at the 2026 Asian Para Games in Nagoya.

title: Morteza Nemati: my brother’s gold doubles my joy in Nagoya
body: TEHRAN - Morteza Nemati is delighted to have won the karate gold medal at the 2026 Asian Games, but his joy has been doubled by the success of his brother, Mahmoud, who also struck gold.
